summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a routine Director/PDMR Shareholding notification under EU and UK Market Abuse Regulation. It discloses a disposal of 1,640 ordinary shares at an aggregated price of 12.104706 GBP per share by a PDMR, Wai-Fung Loh, President Asia. The transaction occurred on December 16, 2025, on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is a standard regulatory disclosure of an insider transaction, not a special situation. There is no event-driven element such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring.
